title: Affine-line unit for the actual finite root line
statement: For a purity finite setting P, h : ramificationIndex divides level, any scheme Y with a morphism a to Spec k, and either Boolean coefficient choice, the specified affine-line relativeUnit of [def-pur-relative-kummer-maps] is an isomorphism in the unbounded derived category. No finite-type hypothesis is required. This is the affine-line part of the relative Kummer calculation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-affine-line-ordinary-invariance] with twist zero. The exact inverse-image single-complex comparisons and the constant-sheaf pullback isomorphism identify the given bounded-below object with constant coefficients. Compatibility of the derived adjunctions and their units then gives invertibility of the unbounded unit.

By [lem-sc-primitive-root], choose a primitive root of the invertible exponent. Its roots-of-unity sheaf trivialization, after scalar extension, identifies the actual twist with constants. Scalar extension from ZMod equals extension of the underlying abelian group: use the canonical Hom-equivalence making every additive map ZMod-linear, then uniqueness of left adjoints. Naturality transports unit invertibility across this isomorphism. The canonical coefficient pullback maps are composites of isomorphisms; their direct images are isomorphisms, so the specified relativeUnit is invertible.

proof_origin.place: The indicated clauses of the relative Kummer proof, with its affine-line input reused from ordinary invariance.
